identity.findings: Plato，约前428/427—前348/347，雅典人，学园创始人，苏格拉底的学生、亚里士多德的老师。家族关系（克里提亚/卡尔米德/继父皮里兰佩斯）据IEP。生年另有前429异说，按约年书写。

sources.title: SEP：Plato（总条目）
sources.readScope: 本回合经结构化提取通读全部小节，逐节核对引语。

sources.title: IEP：Plato
sources.readScope: 本回合经结构化提取通读全文：传记、分期表、学说各节。

checks.claim: 雅典富有政治家族、母系亲戚列名三十僭主、本名阿里斯托克勒斯与绰号、约28岁失师。
checks.locator: Biography节：'one of the wealthiest and most politically active families in Athens'；Critias/Charmides among Thirty Tyrants；birth name likely Aristocles…wrestling-teacher explanation；'he was around 28 when Socrates was killed'（SEP）

checks.claim: 麦加拉与游历、三赴叙拉古与软禁、约前387创办学园与academic词源、亚里士多德二十年。
checks.locator: Biography节：first Megara, then possibly Cyrene, Egypt…'doubtful stories from later antiquity'（卖奴）；Academy…grove sacred to Academus；'This is where we get our word, academic'；Syracuse/Dion段落；the student of Socrates and the teacher of Aristotle

checks.claim: 从不直接发言、从未写论文体；理念论（感官世界有缺陷）、分有、回忆说与美诺演示、灵魂三分与三喻。
checks.locator: Plato's indirectness：'In all of his writings—except in the letters…never speaks to his audience directly'；'never became a writer of philosophical treatises'；Plato's central doctrines：'The world that appears to our senses is in some way defective…'；recollection：'always retains the ability to recollect…'（Meno/Phaedo）；tripartite soul（radical new conception）；另见iep-plato Republic节（三分与akrasia、sun/line/cave）

checks.claim: 晚期作品（六篇文体学认定、无共识为独立阶段）、第三人论证、法律篇对照。
checks.locator: The historical Socrates：'Sophist, Statesman, Timaeus, Critias, and Philebus. These five dialogues together with Laws are generally agreed to be his late works'；'no consensus'；Does Plato change his mind about politics?：'non-philosophers... are given considerable powers as rulers'；Third Man见iep-plato

checks.claim: 学园延续与怀特海语；解释分歧（发展论/统一论）无定论。
checks.locator: The historical Socrates：'it remains a matter of dispute whether the division…does correctly indicate the order of composition'；怀特海语为学界通行引语，概述按通行说法转述

checks.claim: 生年异说、家族两系、前399、游历与卖奴传闻性质、学园、叙拉古与狄翁之死、卒年八十/八十一与葬于学园。
checks.locator: Biography节各段：alternative chronologies (Apollodorus, Diogenes Laertius)；Pyrilampes tied to Pericles' democratic faction；399 execution；Sicily trips/Seventh Letter evidence；Dionysius II/Dion exiled/house arrest；Dion later assassinated；final thirteen years at the Academy；per Diogenes buried there, grave not found；died at eighty or eighty-one

checks.claim: 理念论、回忆说、灵魂三分、洞穴、第三人论证、哲人王六概念。
checks.locator: central doctrines节（forms/recollection/tripartite）；iep-plato（Forms节：imitation of the pure, eternal, unchanging world；Third Man Argument…infinite regress；Republic节：tripartite/rational-spirited-appetitive/justice each part its own/sun-line-cave/philosopher-ruler与叙拉古关联；Laws对照见SEP）

checks.claim: 六部代表作的分期与定位。
checks.locator: Grouping dialogues节分期表（Apology早期；Meno早中过渡；Phaedo/Republic II–X/Symposium中期；Parmenides晚过渡；Laws晚期）；申辩篇'接近历史原型'据亚里士多德看法；法律篇对照见SEP

checks.claim: 五张人物卡与五条关系（苏格拉底/亚里士多德/巴门尼德/赫拉克利特/狄翁）。
checks.locator: intro（student of Socrates, teacher of Aristotle）；Aristotle as source on early dialogues与Third Man objection；赫拉克利特-克拉底鲁关联见SEP相关条目提示（本卡只写困境概括，见iep-plato Forms节语境）；Dion见传记节

checks.claim: 三条路线对应篇目与分期。
发展论/统一论争议、波普尔式政治批评与法律篇对照、第七封信真伪（Burnyeat/Frede）。
checks.locator: The historical Socrates（分期争议）；Dialogue, setting, character：'authenticity…not universally accepted among scholars, and many or most of them are almost certainly not his'（citing Burnyeat and Frede 2015）；Does Plato change his mind about politics?（Laws对照）；波普尔批评为学界通行的争论史实，按争论背景转述
